summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share buybacks under a SEK 15 billion program running April 2026–March 2027. During April 27–May 1, 2026, it repurchased 3,711,316 Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 105.50 per share, for a total transaction value of ~SEK 391.5 million. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. Acquisitions are executed by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE on Nasdaq Stockholm under EU MAR safe harbor. Following these repurchases, Ericsson holds 44,113,592 treasury shares. Watch for ongoing buyback pace and eventual cancellation vote.
